lines.text: Many learners say: I saw him in morning.
Better: I saw him in the morning.
In the morning! I study in the morning.

data.right: I saw him in the morning.

native.tip: हिंदी में “सुबह” अकेला चलता है, पर अंग्रेज़ी में in the morning बोलें।

native.comment: उत्तर: “in the morning”। याद रखें: morning से पहले the लगता है। अब अपना एक वाक्य ज़ोर से बोलिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners drop the, but English says in the morning.
en.caption: Do you say: “I saw him in morning.” 😅 The right sentence is: “I saw him in the morning.” Remember: Put the before morning. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
